ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 60:40 ratio of high-intensity white pixels to low-intensity black/dark-grey pixels across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Extensive vertical and diagonal black striations (mottling) across both lobes. Solid black pigmentation along the distal outer edges and tips. Large contiguous white patch located in the upper-medial region of the right lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central notch with an approximate 45-degree angle and high pixel-depth relative to the lobe width.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serration across the entire trailing edge with prominent triangular peaks and deep valleys, particularly dense on the inner-medial regions of both lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave upward curvature from the median notch transitioning to convex curves towards the lateral tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Highly visible clusters of white, circular, high-contrast calcified barnacles localized on the outer leading edges and the extreme tips of both lobes.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Prominent barnacle colonization along the perimeter. Irregular, deep indentation on the trailing edge of the left lobe near the distal third, suggesting minor tissue loss or trauma.
other_distinctive_markers: Significant asymmetry in pigmentation density between lobes, with the left lobe exhibiting a much higher frequency of dark vertical streaks compared to the right lobe.
